production.overridePolicy: shared Redis is permitted only when queue keys are isolated by ACL/namespace and the capacity review is attached to the release evidence

failureModes.redisUnavailable: permission decisions fail closed; cache reads miss safely; SSE remains durable-catch-up/keepalive-only; queue producers expose degradation
failureModes.staleDescriptor: do not serve without current generation and authorization context
failureModes.cacheStampede: single-flight descriptor compilation and bounded retry/backoff
failureModes.invalidationLag: measure generation lag and fail closed for security-sensitive reads
failureModes.queueBacklog: measure queue latency/backlog and apply bounded admission/backpressure
